mapper.insert: INSERT INTO node_discovery_candidate ( cluster_id, k8s_uid, k8s_node_name, internal_ip, external_ip, observed_role, max_cpu, max_memory, current_cpu, current_memory, observed_status, labels_json, last_seen_at ) VALUES ( #{clusterId}, #{k8sUid}, #{k8sNodeName}, #{internalIp}, #{externalIp}, #{observedRole}, #{maxCpu}, #{maxMemory}, #{currentCpu}, #{currentMemory}, #{observedStatus}, #{labelsJson}, #{lastSeenAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE k8s_node_name = VALUES(k8s_node_name), internal_ip = VALUES(internal_ip), external_ip = VALUES(external_ip), observed_role = VALUES(observed_role), max_cpu = VALUES(max_cpu), max_memory = VALUES(max_memory), current_cpu = VALUES(current_cpu), current_memory = VALUES(current_memory), observed_status = VALUES(observed_status), labels_json = VALUES(labels_json), last_seen_at = VALUES(last_seen_at)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM node_discovery_candidate WHERE cluster_id = #{clusterId} AND k8s_uid = #{k8sUid}

SELECT * FROM node_discovery_candidate WHERE 1 = 1
AND registered_node_id IS NULL
AND cluster_id = #{clusterId}
AND (k8s_node_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR internal_ip LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%'))
ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC, candidate_id DESC
